Synopsis:
Enbridge announced CEO Greg Ebel will retire end-2026, succeeded by insider Michele Harradence, currently head of gas distribution and storage. The transition follows a major expansion phase in which Enbridge acquired three Dominion Energy gas utilities, becoming one of North America's largest integrated gas utility platforms. Harradence brings deep operational expertise in gas utilities and oversaw the Dominion integrations. The company holds a C$41B secured growth backlog across liquids pipelines, gas transmission, storage, utilities and renewables.
